# WisdomTree Reports Monthly Metrics for September 2026


October 12, 2026 6:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4ef78fdb28ae1855633c607598a3ce6b/wisdomtree/news/2026-10-12_WisdomTree_Reports_Monthly_Metrics_for_September_809.pdf)


*7th consecutive quarter of record AUM* *Over $13.5 billion of net inflows year-to-date, a ~13% annualized organic growth rate* *Introduced WisdomTree Onchain™ as tokenized AUM approaches $1.3 billion, up 65% year-to-date*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- WisdomTree, Inc. (NYSE: WT), a global financial innovator, today released monthly metrics for September 2026, including assets under management (AUM) and flow data by asset class.


Note: The table and commentary below exclude AUM and flows related to private assets managed by Ceres Partners, LLC, which had approximately $2 billion in AUM at June 30, 2026. This information is reported with our quarterly earnings results.


Commentary:


- Delivered 7th consecutive quarter of record AUM
- Generated nearly $1.2 billion of net inflows for September despite a challenging market backdrop, bringing year-to-date net inflows to over $13.5 billion, representing a 13% annualized pace of organic growth
- Continued strong UCITS momentum, with $700 million of net inflows in September, AUM up 54% year-to-date and approximately $5.6 billion of net inflows through September, representing a 60% annualized organic growth rate
- Leveraged Atlantic House’s investment capabilities to[launch the first two actively managed defined return UCITS ETFs](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https:/www.wisdomtree.com/gb/press-room/wisdomtree-launches-actively-managed-defined-return-etfs___.YXAzOnZlc3RlZDpjOmdvb2dsZV9tYWlsX2F0dGFjaG1lbnQ6NDUxODVjYTRjZjZhNmI1OTdmMWJjM2QzZGVjYzY0Y2I6Nzo5YzNjOjQyZjE3ZTNkYjhjMWZhNTgxZjIzOTQxNGRhZjY1MzQxODJhODBmZjc4YzA5M2ExNzBhMGNlMTUzZTNlYjhkOWM6cDpUOk4) as part of a broader planned product rollout
- Introduced WisdomTree Onchain to unify our tokenized funds, infrastructure and investor platforms, while expanding distribution through MoonPay, Stable Sea and participation in a regulated USD stablecoin consortium with 21 global financial institutions ([see details here](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https:/ir.wisdomtree.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/807/wisdomtree-introduces-wisdomtree-onchain-as-tokenized___.YXAzOnZlc3RlZDpjOmdvb2dsZV9tYWlsX2F0dGFjaG1lbnQ6NDUxODVjYTRjZjZhNmI1OTdmMWJjM2QzZGVjYzY0Y2I6NzphODA0OmRiZWNkOTYzODgzNGUxZTc0NDYwMDk4ZjJmZjI5ZjY0MjVlMTI5YTQ5NDU0YmEzZGQ3ZTQ2MzY0NTg1ZThhNzk6cDpUOk4) )
- Tokenized AUM approaches $1.3 billion, up 65% year-to-date

**About WisdomTree**


WisdomTree is a global financial innovator, offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products (ETPs), models and solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products. Our offerings empower investors to shape their financial future and equip financial professionals to grow their businesses. Leveraging the latest financial infrastructure, we create products that emphasize access and transparency and provide an enhanced user experience. Building on our heritage of innovation, WisdomTree Onchain™ delivers regulated tokenized funds, stablecoin connectivity, and blockchain-based platforms for individual investors and institutions, while our acquisition of Ceres Partners’ U.S. farmland platform has expanded our capabilities in private markets.


WisdomTree currently has approximately $175.8 billion in assets under management globally, inclusive of assets managed by Ceres Partners, LLC as of the last reportable period.
